ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
summary: Provides affordable pucca housing to eligible urban poor and middle-income households.
benefits: Central assistance for house construction/enhancement, and interest subsidy on home loans under the credit-linked component (where applicable).
eligibility: Household should not own a pucca house anywhere in India
Falls within the scheme's income-category slabs (EWS/LIG/MIG as applicable)
application_steps: Apply online via the PMAY-Urban portal or through the Urban Local Body
